chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who has slaves and bequeaths their manumission for one-third of them. He said, 'Ali (peace be upon him) used to draw lots among them.'

key_terms.يُسْهِمُ: he drew lots / apportioned by lot

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali determine which slaves to free when only a portion was bequeathed for manumission?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the juristic precedent for fulfilling a bequest to free one-third of slaves by using *qur'a* (drawing lots) to select specific individuals, a method attributed to Imam Ali (AS). This practice ensures fairness and clarity in execution, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the practical application of the Prophet's household's traditions in legal matters. It highlights the distinction between proportional manumission and the specific selection process, reinforcing the authority of the Imams in interpreting such bequests.
